pairs.subject: companion-runtime
pairs.evidence: features/dashboard/getDashboardData.ts:1 The context is a read-only instrument panel: its loader composes figures from other modules' loaders and passes them to UI components. A case-insensitive grep of features/dashboard (including components/) for companion, prompt, agent, chat, anthropic and openai found no hits. The only near-match was the substring 'llM' inside 'allMpsLink' in DashboardPage.tsx:518. So no persistent companion, model call, turn stream, action catalog or autonomous cycle exists here, and the subject's precondition does not hold.
